description: A small fire broke out in a shophouse. One person has been pulled out by bystanders and is having difficulty breathing. Smoke and flames are still visible from the building.

examination_findings.head: Soot deposits around nostrils and mouth. Singed nasal hairs — sign of inhalation injury. No head trauma. Pupils equal 4mm, reactive. GCS 14 (E4V4M6). Hoarse voice.
examination_findings.neck: No cervical injury. Trachea midline. Mild stridor audible on auscultation — upper airway oedema developing. No JVD.
examination_findings.chest: ⚠ Bilateral wheezing on auscultation. Intercostal recession visible. RR 30 /min — tachypnoea. SpO2 88% — hypoxia. High-flow oxygen required immediately. Note: SpO2 may be falsely elevated due to CO exposure — consider CO-oximetry.
examination_findings.abdomen: Soft, non-tender. No trauma. No distension.
examination_findings.back: Superficial burns to posterior shoulders — first degree. No spinal tenderness.
examination_findings.extremities: Minor burns to both forearms — first degree, erythematous, no blistering. Distal pulses present. CRT 2.5 sec. No circumferential burns.

symptoms.what_happened: *coughing heavily* ...the fire... I was inside... the smoke...
symptoms.where_hurts: *wheezing* My chest... it burns when I breathe... my throat...
symptoms.when_started: The fire... maybe 10 minutes ago... someone pulled me out...
symptoms.pain_scale: *coughing* ...maybe 5... the breathing is the worst part...

medications.what_meds: Salbutamol inhaler... when I need it... *wheeze*

past_history.medical_conditions: Asthma... since I was a child... *cough*

last_meal.when_ate: I had dinner... maybe 1 hour before the fire...

events.what_doing: I was in the shop... closing up for the night... I smelled smoke... *cough* then the ceiling was on fire...
events.witnesses: My neighbour... he pulled me out... *coughing* ...he's over there...

hazards.description: Active fire in the shophouse — maintain safe distance
Smoke drifting from the building — stay upwind
